ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio with a distribution of approximately 70-75% low-intensity (black) pixels and 25-30% high-intensity (white/mottled) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Predominantly low-intensity dark central lobes. High-intensity white pixels are concentrated heavily at both distal tips and appear as a complex network of linear streaks and circular clusters across the darker interior fields.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Sharp V-shaped central depression with a calculated angle of approximately 50 degrees and a moderate bounding-box depth relative to lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing boundary with frequent, low-to-medium amplitude serrations (peaks and valleys) visible continuously from the notch to the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve beginning at the median notch and sweeping outward toward tapered distal points, with the left lobe exhibiting a slightly more pronounced upward curvature in the current 2D projection.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular and oval high-contrast light clusters concentrated on the distal half of the right lobe and scattered across the lower-central sections of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive network of distinct, unaligned white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) crisscrossing the dark pigmentation on both the left and right lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive rake marks across both lobes; numerous circular scars likely from sessile barnacles; visible encrustations on the outer distal edges of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly unique and dense overlapping pattern of linear scars creating a distinctive geometric 'cross-hatch' effect on the dark pigmentation.
